name: Eaglet

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-002 (amended BIB-0027); member of FAC-caucus-race-company (no uniform)
rendering.species: golden eagle (Aquila chrysaetos) chick, late downy stage with first dark feathers coming through
rendering.limits: Raptor chick anatomy throughout; speech by beak movement. No clothing, no cartoon face.

gender_note.reason: The source calls the Eaglet 'it'. A cheeky young fledgling who mocks the Dodo's long words and hides a smile (ch003-p15); female, the party's youngest.

base_age_note.reason: Persona age (a child younger than Alice), kept for voice casting. As an animal: a golden-eagle chick of about six to seven weeks, still half in down.

hair.color: creamy white-buff down with dark brown contour feathers breaking through on the wings and back
hair.style: fluffy, flyaway, uneven; plastered into wet spikes on arrival, fluffing out enormously as it dries
hair.reason: Wet state sourced; colours follow the species at this stage.

eyes.expression: bright, sharp, mischievous; ducks her head into her down to hide a smile
eyes.quote: the Eaglet bent down its head to hide a smile
eyes.reason: Young golden eagles have dark brown eyes; expression sourced and played as a head-duck.

face.shape: big-headed chick with an oversized hooked beak
features: dark hooked beak with yellow cere

build.height_note: Standing height of a large downy chick.
build.posture: restless, hops rather than walks, flaps half-grown wings
build.scale_reference: The youngest of the party but not the smallest: about the Dodo's chest height, bigger than the Lory and the Canary.
build.reason: Species-true for the chosen stage; 'young' reading kept.

entry_state.state: first seen dripping wet, down plastered flat

marks.description: patchy mix of white down and dark new feathers, her identifier

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: she wears nothing; her look is the half-downy eaglet
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives the Eaglet no clothing; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old frock and feather collar are dropped.

prompt_base_en: photoreal golden eagle chick about six weeks old, fluffy creamy white-buff down with dark brown feathers breaking through on the wings, wet and spiky, oversized dark hooked beak with yellow cere, bright dark eyes, big yellow feet, standing on a muddy pool bank ducking its head mischievously, natural bird anatomy, live-action film plate
